Priya: Quick all-hands follow-up on pricing/quotas. A customer asked how credit bursts work vs hard caps. Can someone give the short canonical answer and any planned changes? @Alex

Alex: We use per-account credit buckets + a small burst pool at the gateway. Burst smooths brief spikes; sustained use hits throttles. We're evaluating widening the burst window but need finance+infra signoff.

Jamal: TL;DR of current rules: bucket refills hourly, 5-minute burst buffer (~10% daily allowance), sustained overage -> tiered throttling. Planning a tiered-burst pilot next quarter.

Maria: Infra note: increasing burst window to 15m is doable but requires limiter change, rollout gating, and extra e2e tests. Canary at 10% traffic looks safe.

Sam: On exemptions: only Enterprise gets contract-based per-account exemptions; Security must approve long-lived exceptions. Ad-hoc short exceptions are rare. I'll draft customer copy.

Priya: Please include example rate-limit headers customers see and the process to request exemptions.

Maria: Example headers:

x-rw-credits-remaining: 1250
x-rw-burst-remaining: 120
x-rw-quota-reset: 1760003600

nodebot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/1769999999

Alex: Action: Product to propose self-serve exemption flow for Dedicated/Enterprise (console UI + ops review). Deliverable: UX + audit trail by EOW.

Lina: Do new signups get a grace period?

Alex: Yes, 15-minute grace for new signups. We'll add exact wording in the draft.

Priya: Thanks. Post the draft here when ready.
